paite: Ka huansung ah ka hong pai hi, ka sanggamnu, ka mou; ka murrah ka gimnamtui toh ka lakhawmta; ka khuaikhak ka khuaizu toh ka neta a; ka uain ka nawitui toh ka dawnta. Aw, lawmte. Ne un; dawn un, ahi, tampi dawn un, Aw ka ngaihnou.
heading: Pasal
english: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Friends Eat, friends! Drink, yes, drink abundantly, beloved.

paite: Ka ihmu a, himahleh ka lungtang ahak; Tua aw, ka ngaihnou kiuhna aw ahi. Pasal' Hon hon in, ka sanggamnu, ka it, ka vahui, ka nin baang lou; ka lutang daitui in adim a, ka samtum lah zan a tui tak in.
heading: La Lina / Numei
english: I was asleep, but my heart was awake. It is the voice of my beloved who knocks: “Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled; for my head is filled with dew, and my hair with the dampness of the night.”

paite: Ka puanak tung ka suahta a; bangchi in ka silh nawn dia? Ka khepekte ka silta a; bangchi in ka hihnin dia?
heading: Numei
english: I have taken off my robe. Indeed, must I put it on? I have washed my feet. Indeed, must I soil them?

paite: Ka ngaihnou in kongkhak awng ah akhut ahon golhlut a, amah ziak in ka lungtang hihlin in a-om hi.
english: My beloved thrust his hand in through the latch opening. My heart pounded for him.

paite: Ka ngaihnou hon ding in ka thouta a; ka khutte murrah in atak a, ka khutzungte murrah tui in, kalhna hekna tung ah.
english: I rose up to open for my beloved. My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with liquid myrrh, on the handles of the lock.

paite: Ka ngaihnou ka honta a; himahleh ka ngaihnou ana kik nawn a, a-omta kei hi. Thu agen lai in ka kha in ahon zuausan a; amah ka zong a, himahleh hon dawng kei hi.
english: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved left, and had gone away. My heart went out when he spoke. I looked for him, but I didn’t find him. I called him, but he didn’t answer.

paite: Khopi a vialvak veng mite'n ahon mu ua, ahon khen ua, ahon liamsak uh; kulhbaang ngakte'n ka puanak ahon lakmangsak uh.
english: The watchmen who go about the city found me. They beat me. They bruised me. The keepers of the walls took my cloak away from me.

paite: K'on ngen ahi, Aw Jerusalem tanute, Ka ngaihnou na muh uleh, zawlngai in ka chi ana chih, amah na hilh un aw.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.

paite: Na ngaihnou, ngaihnou dang sang a atuansemna bang ahia? Aw nang numeite lak a kilawmpen? Na ngaihnou, ngaihnou dang sang a atuansemna bang ahia, huchibang na hon nget?
heading: Numeite
english: How is your beloved better than another beloved, you fairest among women? How is your beloved better than another beloved, that you do so adjure us?

paite: Ka ngaihnou zaw asan hiuhiau a, singkhat lak a makai lianpen ahi.
heading: Numei
english: My beloved is white and ruddy. The best among ten thousand.

paite: Alutang dangka-eng hoihpen abang a, asamtumte alian a, va-ak bang in avom hi.
english: His head is like the purest gold. His hair is bushy, black as a raven.

paite: Amitte luita tui kiang a vahui bang ahi a; nawitui a sil, kituaktak a bulh ahi.
english: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks, washed with milk, mounted like jewels.

paite: Abiangte gimnamtui omna bang ahi a, loupa gimlim bang; amukte lili pak bang ahi a, murrah tui takkhesak in.
english: His cheeks are like a bed of spices with towers of perfumes. His lips are like lilies, dropping liquid myrrh.

paite: Akhutte dangka-eng zungbuh beril suangmantam siatna bang ahi; apumpi saiha a bawl sapphir suangmantam a luan bang ahi.
english: His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl. His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires.

paite: Akhete suangpak khuam, dangka-eng hoihte kuak a kitung bang ahi; Akilatdan Lebanon bang, sidar bang a thupi ahi.
english: His legs are like pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.

paite: Akam akhum penpen a; ahi, angaihhuai tuntun hi. Hiai ka ngaihnou ahi a, hiai ka lawm ahi. Aw Jerusalem tanute.
english: His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.
